_about: Setups not shown on the site yet (common.HELD), name: reason. Earlier late entries (Drex, REAX 1.3) were shown automatically from their first late-entry match; a held one is left out of every page, data file, leaderboard row, bench score and model list (analysis.late_entries, cup.classify) until its line is removed here, once its entry is complete. "running" (common.RUNNING; Ümit via Zeki #5001), name: a held late entry shown while it plays as one unranked row of the home leaderboard, rank '–', no score, its status 'Running · n of N matches' (n: its finished valid late-entry matches in its late-entry league, read from the snapshot of v3.db at build time; N: the original table field_league it plays, without it) and, in its details, the league, its start, route, runner commits and the pairs still pending; still held everywhere else. A running name must also be under held; remove both lines once its entry is complete.
